open_water_descriptive_sanity_bounds.mandatory_warning: Arctic open-water temperatures are reduced-sector diagnostics. The OISST ranges were inspected during tuning and are descriptive sanity bounds only; source files, release-time hashes, and processed observational summaries are not packaged, so this is not an independent or reproduced quantitative observational validation or a local, coastal, or regional forecast test.

scope.interpretation: Broad tuning-informed reduced-sector temperature sanity check only. It is not independent pointwise SST skill, a regional forecast test, or quantitative validation.
scope.open_water_definition: OISST sea-ice concentration is converted to open_water_fraction=clip(1-ice_concentration,0,1) and included in the weights.
scope.sector_mask: The processor imports climate_model._atlantic_basin_fraction and applies the same smooth fractional Atlantic mask used by the model; non-Atlantic is ocean_fraction minus that Atlantic fraction.

amoc.role: sensitivity emulator with full anomalous thermal-density coupling restored
amoc.warning: Scenario weakening and hosing response are sensitivity results, not precise collapse probability or timing forecasts.

arctic_open_water_temperature.validation: tuning-informed broad NOAA OISST descriptive sanity bounds using the model-derived Atlantic fraction mask; not a reproduced quantitative observational validation
arctic_open_water_temperature.warning: Do not interpret as a local, coastal, or point forecast.

greenland.warning: Total contribution is scenario-sensitive; regional geometry and outlet-glacier evolution are not resolved.

sea_ice.calibration_period: NOAA/NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4 March/September 1979-2020
sea_ice.future_projection_role: native thermodynamic area is a sensitivity output; frozen zero-intercept seasonal scaling is used only for secondary 15%-concentration extent
sea_ice.longitude_skill: none; optional longitude occupancy is a deterministic area-preserving display reconstruction
sea_ice.role: native two-sector thermodynamic Northern Hemisphere area with an extent-only observation operator
sea_ice.validation_informed_development_period: 2021-2025; inspected during v2.29.5-v2.29.14 development and not independent

evidence_partition.rolling_origin_historical_evaluation: descriptive only and non-release-blocking because all historical records have been inspected
evidence_partition.structural_tests: conservation, control stability, timestep, hosing, resolution, native sea-ice integrity and software regressions
evidence_partition.tuning_informed_development_regressions: IPCC/literature ranges and sea-ice records through 2025 used during development; not independent validation
evidence_partition.tuning_informed_external_sanity_check: broad NOAA OISST open-water temperature ranges inspected during v2.29.14 tuning; not independent validation

evidence_partition.1979-2020: calibration and validation-informed development; not independent validation
evidence_partition.2021-2025: previously inspected development-evaluation data; not an independent holdout
evidence_partition.2026: March record was already available and inspected; not untouched
evidence_partition.2027-onward: reserved prospectively and must not be used for tuning before evaluation

source_product_transition.interpretation: The packaged table preserves the Sea Ice Index v4 source-data identifiers. No claim is made that NSIDC-0051 and NSIDC-0803 are measurement-identical; product transition effects are part of the observational uncertainty.

march_area.interpretation: Non-overlapping five-year target blocks reduce shared-year leakage, but the emulator trajectory was tuned after the historical record was inspected. Scores are descriptive development diagnostics, not predictive validation.

march_native_area_trend_robustness.mandatory_limitation: March native-area temporal dynamics remain a tuning-informed limitation unless both the <=2x trend-ratio and >=0.30 interannual-correlation criteria are met. The response is not independently validated; failure is non-release-blocking but must be prominent.

prospective_untouched_temporal_evaluatio.reason: Records through 2025 and March 2026 were already inspected; 2027 onward is the next defensible untouched window.

quantitative_temporal_skill_claim.reason: The historical record was inspected during development and does not constitute independent predictive validation, irrespective of baseline skill.

rolling_origin_historical_evaluation.method: Each target year is compared with the fixed emulator trajectory, one-year observed persistence, and an expanding observed linear trend estimated only from prior years.

ssp245_future_sea_ice_sensitivity.interpretation: Native prognostic thermodynamic area is a future sensitivity output. The fixed zero-intercept historical operator is used only for 15% secondary extent. No post-2020 trend, scenario closure, or future-target adjustment is applied. Longitude reconstruction is display-only and has no regional predictive skill. Ice-free timing is a threshold-crossing sensitivity, not a forecast.
